note: Captured live from TfL Unified API 7 Sep 2026 for docs/jim-brief-london-station-name-prefix.md. arrivalDepartures[naptanId][lineName] holds raw /StopPoint/{naptanId}/ArrivalDepartures?lineIds=<lineId> rows for the five NR-backed Overground stations affected by the leading "London " disambiguation-prefix bug (Cheshunt, Chingford, Enfield Town, Watford Junction, Walthamstow Central). Self-terminating rows (destinationName equals the queried station) are TfL-real and included verbatim; parseTflArrivalDeparture drops them (no departure field) per the existing terminus-handling verdict.
